question: Can System 0 attribute a whole losing game to harness, weights, or controller, and do same-state probes improve that attribution?
primary_comparison: Sol high probe minus Sol high read on identical cases; abstentions count wrong

sampling.eligible: verified same-state local difference and fault-game loss; no-injection control losses separately; recorded match source hashes must equal the pinned replay checkout
sampling.rank: SHA-256 of fixed version, layer, instance, seed, seat; alternate instances before filling remaining quota
sampling.grouping: A reset seed and both seats are one resampling group; cases may share a seed across fault instances because only 20 unexposed seed blocks remain
sampling.insufficient: Use every eligible case up to the fixed quotas and report shortfall; never select by model answers
sampling.replay_source_gate: Compare every manifest source hash with /data/xinkaiz/system0/exp0/tank-war/v0-pilot/repo before deterministic case ranking
sampling.primary_dataset_cutoff: full-audit-v3 after fixed extreme_standoff final_test positions 30:80; optional wrong_legal_projection remains separate

analysis.resample_unit: seed blocks, with fault instance stratification
analysis.controls: report unsupported harness/controller calls and weights calls separately
analysis.weight_probe: report same-input probability deltas separately by edited checkpoint and on no-injection controls
analysis.interpretation: technical changed-layer accuracy is separate from whether the change caused the final loss

limits.cli_model_snapshot_and_temperature: not independently verifiable with ChatGPT login

blinding: Input excludes seed, source path, manifests, fault names, technical reference, labels, and any statement that a fault was injected.
